title: STAR TREK: THE NEXT GENERATION
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: Seven seasons aboard the Enterprise-D, charted season by season: who was running the writers' room, who was running sickbay, and every return of Q, the Borg, the Romulans, the Klingon High Council and the Cardassians.
regularsNote: Series regulars — Picard, Riker, Data, Worf, Geordi, Troi, Beverly and Wesley Crusher, Tasha Yar and Dr. Pulaski — aren't listed here; this dropdown covers the guest and recurring cast, which is where Q, Guinan, O'Brien, Ro Laren, Barclay, Lwaxana Troi and the Klingon High Council live.
chartHint: Seven seasons across. Click any bar to filter the episode list; mid-season changes are drawn at season granularity with the exact episode in the label. For single-episode arcs, the vibe filters (Q, Borg, Romulans…) are more precise than the bars.
credits: Episode data, images and ratings from TVmaze. Chart hand-built from the series.
